notes:
- The Color Wheels grade the tones you see: the Highlights wheel reaches your highlights, and Shadows no longer spills into the midtones. Grades made before this update can look different.
- Detail's band weights, Grain's band gains and Tone Mask use the same tonal ranges as the Color Wheels.
- Color wheel pucks follow a drag past the rim, keep their strength when grabbed, stay in range from the keyboard, and are read out to screen readers.
- Color Tune's band wheel turns a color family one way, matches the colors drawn on it, and moves the way the arrow keys point.
- Color Tune and Recolor look the same at 1:1 as in the export, and keep gray edges out of a neighboring color's grade.
- The Color Tune and Relight pop-out windows edit the selected layer.
- View depth shows reliably at Fit and when zoomed in.
- Show mask turns orange and says so when View depth or another view is showing instead.
- Deleting a layer turns off its mask and depth views, and a new layer starts on the photograph.
- On a Mac, Control-click adds photographs to the selection, so several stacks or photos move to the Trash together.
- Heeler opens with the cursor rather than the last tool in hand, and V puts any tool or picker away.
- The thumbnail strip reopens centered on the current photo.
- The Spectrums keep your scope and settings when popped out, and the waveform's EV scale is easy to read.
- The cursor readout and Preferences fit at larger App Zoom settings.
- The Graph inspector no longer shows an Opacity slider on Color Balance that never changed the picture.
